tools.name: failfirst_baseline
tools.description: Run the acceptance criteria on the UNFIXED state and write the lockfile (.failfirst.lock.json). Call once, before any work. Returns a baseline report; exit_code 0 means every machine criterion failed as required. Refuses to overwrite an existing lockfile (FF_E_LOCK_EXISTS).

criteria.description: Path to the criteria file (.json/.yaml). Default: failfirst.yaml, failfirst.yml, failfirst.json, criteria.yaml, criteria.yml or criteria.json in the working directory.

lock.description: Lockfile path. Default: .failfirst.lock.json next to the criteria file.

dry_run.description: Run the criteria and report, but write no lockfile and no report file.

force.description: Overwrite an existing lockfile. Destroys the failure evidence; only a human owner should set this.

tools.name: failfirst_verify
tools.description: Re-run the criteria AFTER the work and check each was proven: failed at baseline, unchanged since, and passes now. Returns a verify report; status is pass, fail or awaiting_review. Needs a lockfile from failfirst_baseline (FF_E_NO_LOCK otherwise).

criteria.description: Path to the criteria file (.json/.yaml). Default: failfirst.yaml, failfirst.yml, failfirst.json, criteria.yaml, criteria.yml or criteria.json in the working directory.

lock.description: Lockfile path. Default: .failfirst.lock.json next to the criteria file.

FF_E_USAGE.hint: Run `failfirst --help`. Commands: baseline, verify, describe, mcp.

FF_E_NO_CRITERIA.hint: Create failfirst.yaml (see AGENTS.md) or pass the criteria file path as the first argument.

FF_E_BAD_CRITERIA.hint: Fix the criteria file: ids unique, every criterion needs a check (cmd, argv, path or url) or judgment: true, unknown fields are rejected. See spec/SPEC.md section 1.

FF_E_LOCK_EXISTS.hint: A baseline already exists; keep it. Re-baselining erases the failure evidence, so only a human owner should pass --force.

FF_E_NO_LOCK.hint: Run `failfirst baseline` on the unfixed state before the work, then verify.

FF_E_BAD_LOCK.hint: The lockfile is corrupt or from another version. Restore it from version control; do not re-baseline after the fix.

FF_E_IO.hint: A file could not be read or written (permissions, missing directory). Check the --lock / --report path and the working directory.

FF_E_INTERNAL.hint: Unexpected failure in failfirst itself. Re-run with the same arguments and report the message.
